findings.title: The connector makes one cosmic pair

findings.containment: This is a local syntactic pairing; it does not add an independent cosmological inventory beyond the two named poles.

findings.containment: The sight branch is retained; no separate inner-knowledge branch is asserted by this finding.

epistemic.reason: Trusted word analysis, QAC alignment, and the exact formula contact support the local grammatical effect.
